name: filter-keys
intro: The 408 filter keys OpenAEV 3.261116.1 accepts: in the filter menus of its lists and in the `filterGroup` of its search endpoints (one section per object), and in the filters of the dashboard widgets (one section per kind of document). A filter is `{"key", "operator", "mode", "values"}`; the 12 operators are `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `not_starts_with`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `empty`, `not_empty`. **Operators** lists those the interface offers for the key; **Also** says whether the key sorts a list (`sorts`) and whether `textSearch` searches it. [Filters](/develop/apis/filters/#openaev-filters) explains the format.

sections.title: Asset
sections.text: Schema: `POST /api/schemas/Asset?filterableOnly=true`. The keys of its kinds are included, and their schemas give the part each one has: `Endpoint`, `SecurityPlatform`.
